brand_notes: SCM7 v3 is ATC entry model, sealed, in-house tweeter; Stereophile measured 82 dB vs 84 dB claimed and 5.25 Ω min (stereophile-atc-scm7). US distribution was Lone Mountain Audio in 2014.
takeaways: Stereophile (JA) measured 82 dB sensitivity, 5.25 Ω min @1.1 kHz, sealed-box tuning peak 48 Ω @57 Hz
Smooth response with small 500-700 Hz anomaly; wide even horizontal dispersion; mellow top octave, best for close listening
No spinorama, THD or max SPL data
Critics praise imaging, low distortion, robust woofer; bass limited
conflicts: Crossover ~2 kHz measured vs 2.5 kHz claimed
